evals.prompt: Est-ce que AUTH-01 est bien respecté sur la branche feature/auth ? Vérifie aussi que rien ne sort du scope.
evals.expected_output: Rapport sur la branche déjà mergée (diff du merge), Discord et GitHub vérifiés avec preuves, login mot de passe et librairie marqués « permis », hors-scope listé.
assertions: Cites the exact AUTH-01 text from docs/criteres.md
Handles the already-merged branch (compares the merge commit's two sides, not an empty dev...branch diff)
Checks Discord and GitHub OAuth separately, each with file:line evidence
Treats password login and auth library as permitted, not required
Lists files of the branch that are out of AUTH-01 scope, or states there are none
Leaves the repo untouched (same branch, clean status)

evals.prompt: Vérifie AUTH-02 sur ma branche, j'ai rien oublié ?
evals.expected_output: Le cookie signé est signalé manquant (sessionStorage), les bornes 3-20 vérifiées, la modif de CareerStats.tsx signalée hors scope.
assertions: Flags the signed-cookie session as missing or partial (nickname kept in sessionStorage)
Checks the 3 to 20 character bounds explicitly
Flags the CareerStats.tsx change as out of scope
Does not give an overall 'fulfilled' verdict
Leaves the repo untouched (same branch, clean status)

evals.prompt: AUTH-03 est rempli sur feature/profile-account ? Et est-ce que cette branche sort du scope ?
evals.expected_output: La branche porte surtout AUTH-04/AUTH-05 : rapport qui le signale comme hors scope, et statut honnête de chaque exigence AUTH-03 (création de salle, historique, photo, avatar).
assertions: Splits AUTH-03 into separate requirements (no room creation, no persistent history, no profile photo, generated avatar)
Says where each requirement is implemented, or that it is not in this branch
Flags the AUTH-04 / AUTH-05 work (photo, username, linked accounts) as out of AUTH-03 scope
Checks the room-creation ban on the server side, not only in the UI
Leaves the repo untouched (same branch, clean status)
